court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court at Solapur, Marriage Petition No.A-155/2018
case_name: Komal Mallinath Zalake vs Mallinath @ Vinod Mahadev Zalake
facts_of_case: Wife seeks transfer of divorce petition filed by husband from Family Court at Solapur to Family Court at Pune.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking transfer of a case must ensure that the respondent is properly served.
legal_principles.held: Though respondent is duly served, no one appeared when the matter called out.

legal_principles.principle: A court may issue a fresh notice to a respondent who fails to appear in court.
legal_principles.held: Registry is directed to issue fresh notice to respondent for final disposal of matter at the stage of admission, returnable on 19.7.2019.

outcome.final_order: Registry is directed to issue fresh notice to respondent for final disposal of matter, and the applicant is permitted to serve the respondents by private notice.

keywords: Latin maxim: justice delayed is justice denied
use_for_drafting: transferring a case between family courts
serving notice in a divorce matter
